messages:
Incident Bot: Pager opened — SEV2: hosted-runtime kv_cache runaway (us-west-2). alert id=INC-3141599999
Sara Patel: i'm looking at prod-us-west-2, several serving-runtime pods restarted, OOMs spiking. GC logs flooded.
Kai Chen: oncall here. paste top kvmap stats and recent deploys pls.
Sara Patel: logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T05:07:12Z] serve_runtime: pid=9213 killed by OOM, rss=63.2GB
[2026-03-15T05:07:12Z] kv_map.total_entries=1_200_000 kv_map.estimated_bytes=52_800_000_000
[2026-03-15T05:07:12Z] continuous_batcher.prefetch_inflight=312 prefix_prefetch.mode=heuristic
```
Ashley Rivera: that growth curve is exponential. i see a cluster of very long system prompts from a handful of sessions — looks like iterative transcript appends. prefetch is aggressively warming KV for long prefixes.
Emma Gómez: support reports NotebookFlow and AcmeAnalytics saw 5xx errors and 10-30s tails around 05:05-05:12 UTC; CS opened tickets.
Michael Tran: any config changes in last 48h?
Ashley Rivera: no runtime image changes. we did flip default batch sizing in config last week (`batch_window_tokens=65536`) which could interact badly with prefetch on heavy sessions.
Kai Chen: mitigation plan: 1) disable prefix prefetch via feature flag in region, 2) enforce emergency per-session kv cap, 3) roll a runtime hotpatch with aggressive eviction policy to canary. i'll coordinate.
Sara Patel: disabling prefetch via runtime feature flag now. command used:
```
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://ops-api.us-west-2.internal/flags/prefix_prefetch -d '{"enabled":false}'
```
Deploy Bot: flag change applied to prod-us-west-2 at 3141599999. propagation started.
Ashley Rivera: building hotpatch runtime:v3.14.2-ecap to enforce `kv_cache.session_max=200k` and `kv_cache.eviction=aggressive-timebased`.
Deploy Bot: canary deploy runtime:v3.14.2-ecap -> 5% pods.
Ashley Rivera: canary metrics (2m): canary pods kv_map median=95k entries, non-canary median=820k. memory headroom on canary +18GB.
Kai Chen: good. increase to 40% and keep prefetch off. watch error rates.
Sara Patel: error rate dropped from 6.1% -> 1.0%. p99 latency improved ~1.2s. still seeing some residual high-mem pods but no new OOMs in last 8m.
Emma Gómez: notifying customers: sending interim update to affected customers, letting them know mitigation in place and we will follow up with RCA.
Michael Tran: assign owners: Ashley (runtime fix), Sara (incident lead), Emma (customer comms), Kai (post-incident scoreboard). deliverables: timeline, mitigation steps, telemetry gaps, and change to prefetch heuristics. due EOD.
Ashley Rivera: preliminary RCA: interactive long prompts with repeated system role appends caused sessions to accumulate huge prefix contexts. continuous_batcher combined with recently relaxed `batch_window_tokens` and prefix prefetch heuristics led to prefetching multi-MB KV blobs per session, causing kv_map to blow out memory.
Kai Chen: proposed longer-term actions: 1) session-level soft cap + hard eviction 2) prefetch to respect token-length thresholds and sample-based prewarming 3) continuous_batcher backpressure when per-session kv growth rate > threshold 4) add alerting on kv_map growth slope and per-session memory.
Sara Patel: immediate followups: keep prefix prefetch disabled until hotpatch is in all regions; roll hotpatch global; add temporary alarm thresholds; run a retro to tighten defaults.
Ashley Rivera: global rollout started at 3141600200. runtime pods will report `kv_cache.cap_enforced=true` in logs when the change is active.
Deploy Bot: global rollout progressing -> 100% in 12m.
Sara Patel: post-rollout check: no new OOMs across prod-us-west-2 in last 20m. memory usage stabilized.
Emma Gómez: CS: customers acknowledged reduced errors, asked whether we can search logs to see if their sessions were the root cause — said yes, we will include evidence in postmortem.
Michael Tran: if anything regresses re-open pager. otherwise please create incident ticket linking to this thread and schedule RCA meeting.
Kai Chen: handing off to morning oncall at 3141600600. handoff note: prefetch disabled, kv session cap in place, hotpatch deployed globally, alert thresholds tightened.
Incident Bot: Pager closed by Kai Chen at 3141600600 — mitigated. postmortem in progress.
